meta.name: Mukesh Jasoos
meta.description:
A quintessential loser and detective with questionable skills and laughable methods navigates through petty crimes. However, something sinister is brewing.

Returning Series · First aired 6 May 2021 · India · Language: Hindi · 13 min
Studio: Humara Movie · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Ab Banenge Jasoos!
videos.overview: As LLB-failed Mukesh can no longer practise law, he and his friend look for greener pastures. Hope comes in the form of Asharam. Meanwhile, a young girl’s corpse gets disposed off.

videos.title: Baap re Baap
videos.overview: The 'Jasoos Team' Mukesh and Muktaram's ill-planned and poorly executed attempts to follow Asharam's wife lands them in trouble. However, they stumble upon a secret.

videos.title: Baaz ki Nazar
videos.overview: Police Inspector Umesh Singh discovers the dead body of a girl. A robbery at Vitthalbhai's provides Mukesh with the opportunity of solving another case.

videos.title: Pyaar ko Rahne Do
videos.overview: Although the prime suspect, Vitthalbhai's son seems innocent and the Jasoos Team hatches a hare-brained scheme to help him. Meanwhile, another girl has been missing for two days.

videos.title: Virginto
videos.overview: Mukesh and Muktaram decide to investigate Aalia’s murder to help Arjun. This leads them to cross paths with Virginto Oil and the charming Kalyani.

videos.title: Poha Khaoge
videos.overview: Mukesh blames himself for a recent suicide. He and Muktaram start having doubts about continuing their new profession and their future.

videos.title: Gobar Pe Cherry
videos.overview: Pooja brings a new case for Mukesh - her background check for marriage. And for Muktaram - heartache. The investigation again leads Mukesh to Kalyani.

videos.title: Photo ke Peeche Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Tinkoo is in the business of creating pornographic videos. Heartbroken that Pooja is getting married, Muktaram search for an escort service, where he makes a startling discovery.

videos.title: Kuch Toh Connection Hai
videos.overview: The Jasoos Team follows Pooja to a hotel where they see more girls. Mukesh connects the dots and informs Umesh Singh.

videos.title: Kanoon Ka Khel
videos.overview: Umesh Singh hauls in Kalyani for questioning. This disturbs Mukesh, who has a soft corner for her. At home, Sulekha is upset with Mukesh for not taking care of Sumati.

videos.title: New Arrangement
videos.overview: Mukesh and Kalyani seem to be developing a bond, but he is hesitant because of Sulekha. The Jasoos Team struggles for a lead in Aalia’s case. Elsewhere, Pooja is up to something.

videos.title: Aapko Kahin Dekha Hai
videos.overview: At a Virginto Oil recruitment event, Kalyani encourages Sulekha to become a Virginto sales girl. When the presence of a certain someone makes Kalyani uncomfortable, Mukesh notices.

videos.title: Ulta Daav
videos.overview: Sulekha and Kalyani start working together. Anubhav gets greedy and tries to blackmail Tinkoo, which brings him face to face with Tinkoo’s boss, Iqbal Khan.

videos.title: By God's Grace
videos.overview: A disturbed Anubhav tells Sulekha that he has managed to get her an audition for a film. However, the audition's address bothers Mukesh. Something is not right.

videos.title: Kisi Ne Jaan Li, Kisi Ne Jaan Di
videos.overview: Sulekha is upset with Mukesh’s lack of enthusiasm. As a scared Anubhav is seen leaving without Sulekha from the auditions, the Jasoos Team realises it's a trap.

videos.title: Badla Yeh Mausam
videos.overview: Sulekha is heartbroken, and Mukesh tries to console her. On the other hand, Tinkoo and Iqbal need to cover their tracks before anything is leaked.

videos.title: Muktaram Ki Maat
videos.overview: Tinkoo kidnaps Anubhav and plans to frame him. However, Muktaram, who has been following Tinkoo, figures out the actual owner of his scooty - a dead girl.

videos.title: Tick-Tock
videos.overview: Mukesh figures out Umesh Singh’s involvement and follows him to Tinkoo’s residence. Meanwhile, Pooja is sent on a deadly mission.

videos.title: Purana Sach
videos.overview: When Iqbal becomes a liability, Kalyani takes a decision. Mukesh and Muktaram start to piece together the clues, and they zero in on a suspect.

videos.title: Mukesh Jasoos - Eshtablish
videos.overview: Mukesh's curiosity leads him to the Virginto Oil’s manufacturing address. His findings help him to deduce the truth while there's a ticking time bomb in Iqbal's car.
